standard_prerequisites.name: The morphism attached to a pencil
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the morphism phi: X -> P^1 of the g^1_d with L' = phi^*O(1) receiving a nonzero map from the pencil.

standard_prerequisites.name: Degree bookkeeping for invertible sheaves
standard_prerequisites.use: Bounds 0 <= deg(L') <= d, forces L' trivial at degree zero, and gives the degree formula for the pullback under a nonconstant map.

core_obligations: Degree bounds (proof lines 638-645): the nonzero map L' -> L with L' = phi^*O(1) gives 0 <= deg(L') <= d by the invertible-sheaf comparison lemma.

Case split (proof lines 645-658): if deg(L') = 0 then L' is trivial and the two independent sections exhibit H^0(X, O_X) != k, case (2); if deg(L') > 0 then phi is nonconstant since constant pullbacks are trivial, and deg(L') = deg(X/P^1) deg(O(1)) = deg(X/P^1) <= d, case (1).
proof_roadmap: Pull back O(1) along the pencil map and bound its degree.
Dispatch the degree-zero case via triviality and independent sections.
Dispatch the positive-degree case via nonconstancy and the degree formula.

The proof (lines 638-658) is complete: the degree bounds from the nonzero map, the triviality case with its global-functions consequence, and the nonconstant case with the degree formula and O(1) of degree one. Every step is present with no omissions. H2: a short case split with standard degree bookkeeping.
